This has happened to me so many times!

This is exactly why I switched from sniper main to Ambyspy. Snipers think their scope gives them an advantage, but in reality it just gives the advantage to the spy; snipers have to slow down to a crawl to score a headshot & spies can do it in the air at full speed.

However, this does have the effect of leaving me exposed and in the direct line of fire of more than one enemy. I love a challenge. If I were a pussy, I'd use the Dead Ringer to mitigate the danger. Screw that.

Unless I'm assaulting a well-guarded & well-positioned sentry nest (or a heavy with a particularly bad case of Tunnel Vision), I just stick with headshots. Soldier? Demo? Pyro? Two headshots take most down. I call this strategy le Tireur Française d'Élite.
